statement.essentials: Some surgeons argue that for a benign tumour a cuff of normal gland, not the whole outer lobe, is all that is needed, so the extent is a judgement.
statement.anatomy: One protocol states that removing a cuff of parotid tissue around the tumour, without a total lobectomy, is all that is necessary for benign tumours, that adequate resection may need part of the deep lobe, and that en bloc removal with a cuff is usually possible only for tumours in the tail.

limitations: An institutional opinion, not a trial result; chapter 6 sets out how the evidence is split.
